items.text: तज्ज्ञैरुपाहृतान्भक्ष्यान् साधुशूल्यामिषाणि च कुन्दप्रभाणि भक्तानि भक्षयेदनुयायिभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ताम्बूलाद्युपयुज्याथ शान्ततेजसि भास्वति स्वावासाय समागच्छेत्कथाः कुर्वन् पृथग्विधाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कुह्यामुपकथं क्रौञ्चो धूत्या लावो ऽतिगर्ववान्नैकधा वाजिना सोऽयं तृणबर्हिर्यथा हतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शिकारेणामुना ब्रूमः कथं तित्तिरिनिग्रहः श्येनिकेनामुना मोकः सोल्लासस्फूर्जितस्ततः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथाधमेनामुना तु तिर्यक्क्षिप्तो न चोत्थितः एतस्य पत्री न तथा विरोधमुपपद्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वर्जयेत्सर्वमांसानि धर्मो ह्यत्र विधीयते मांसं तु [... औ३ लेत्तेरौस्झ्झ्] सर्वराजभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वभूतात्मभूतैस्तैः [... औ२ लेत्तेरौस्झ्झ्] परावरैः नाभागेनाम्बरीषेण रामेण च महात्मना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऐलेन पृथुना चैव वीरसेनेन चैव हि हर्यश्वेन च राजेन्द्र भूपेन भरतेन च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एतैश्चान्यैश्च राजेन्द्र पुरा मांसं न भक्षितम् शारदे कौमुदपक्षे ततस्ते स्वर्गमाप्नुवन्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्रह्मलोके च तिष्ठन्ति कल्पमानाः स्त्रिया वृताः यथा तत्रैव विहिता मृगयान्यत्र कौमुदात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अनिषिद्धात्त्वन्यदा सा तत्रैव परिवर्जयेत्प्रजानां हितकामेन ह्यगस्त्येन महात्मना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आरण्याः सर्वदैवत्याः प्रोक्षिताः तामसा मृगाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: युक्त्या शरदि सेवेत यथाच्छन्दं हिमागमे वसन्ते तु प्रकर्षेण बलारोग्यमभीप्सुभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: धनुर्वेदाभ्यासः समविधिरनूनश्च लघुता गतेर्गात्रोत्साहः तुरगविहृतौ चातिपटुता तथा नीतेर्योगे रसपरिचयश्चाप्यनुपमो मृगव्यायां क्षात्रो गुणसमुदयो ऽभ्यस्यत इव
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: इति श्रीरुद्रदेवविरचिते श्यैनिके शास्त्रे मृगयानन्तरेतिकर्तव्यता परिच्छेदः सप्तमः
